description: Retrieve IODA detection and recovery transitions in an explicit Unix-second window of at most 31 days. Omit entity filters for global scope; a code requires entityType. relatedToType and relatedToCode limit results to entityType entities within one country, region, ASN, or geoasn, served at page 0 only. Each transition retains its source, level, condition, value and baseline; levels and baselines are not a source-independent severity scale. Transitions include both requested bounds, widened by extendWindowSeconds; adjacent windows can duplicate boundary detections. ignoreMethods excludes source.method, source.*, or *.method upstream. Missing transitions do not establish health. Pages are zero-based; keep filters and limit fixed.

entityCode.description: Two-letter country code, IODA numeric region code, decimal ASN (AS prefix accepted), or geoasn code joining an ASN and a region or country code (40934-576, 59962-IR); resolve names with ioda_search_entities and pass a returned code here.

entityType.description: country, region, asn, or geoasn (one ASN within a region or country); whitespace and case are normalized.

extendWindowSeconds.description: Seconds before from and after until to also return transitions from; zero, the default, returns only transitions inside the window. Without entityType, large extensions are slow globally and can time out, so add entityType or keep the extension small. Values above 1209600 (14 days) are served as 1209600 with a notice.

from.description: Inclusive Unix seconds UTC; no milliseconds; window at most 31 days.

ignoreMethods.description: Detection methods to exclude upstream before event construction and scoring; duplicates are removed, and an empty array excludes nothing. Keep fixed across ranking and drill-down calls.

items.description: One detection method exclusion; case and surrounding whitespace are normalized.

limit.description: Upstream page size; values above 100 are served as 100 with a notice. Keep fixed when continuing.

page.description: Zero-based upstream page; restart at 0 when changing limit.

relatedToCode.description: Scope entity code, normalized like entityCode for relatedToType (IR, 1829, AS42337, 60627-IR); resolve names with ioda_search_entities. Provide with relatedToType.

relatedToType.description: Scope type: country, region, asn, or geoasn. With relatedToCode, returns entityType entities related to that entity, such as the regions or networks of one country. Requires entityType and excludes entityCode; blank is omitted. Outage membership coverage is unverified independently of row pagination; page ioda_search_entities and query selected codes individually.

source.description: bgp, ping-slash24, merit-nt, or gtr; blank means all sources. Case and whitespace are normalized.

until.description: Inclusive Unix seconds UTC for transition/event-start selection, after from and no later than now; adjacent windows can duplicate boundary detections.

name: ioda_get_alerts

alerts.description: Literal detection and recovery transitions with source baselines.

subnames.description: Additional source names, preserved verbatim: usually a list; geoasn search rows carry named parts such as asn and region or country

historyValue.description: Source baseline that value is compared with, on the same per-source scale as value: the source unit for bgp, ping-slash24, and merit-nt; Traffic divided by 1,000,000 and truncated for gtr.

value.description: Source measurement at the transition. bgp (Visible /24s), ping-slash24 (Up /24s), and merit-nt (Unique Source IPs) report it in the source unit; gtr (method sarima) reports IODA Traffic divided by 1,000,000 and truncated to an integer.

applied.description: Every normalized input, effective window, filter and pagination value.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_ignore_methods`: An explicit source is also excluded by its own source.* entry. `invalid_entity`: entityCode is incompatible with entityType, zero or out of range, or supplied without entityType. `invalid_scope`: relatedToType and relatedToCode are incomplete or incompatible, the code is zero or out of range, a scope lacks entityType or comes with entityCode, or a scope asks for a page above 0. `invalid_window`: Reversed, future, millisecond, or over-31-day window. `upstream_bad_request`: IODA rejects the request with HTTP 400 or an error envelope. `upstream_unprocessable`: IODA rejects the request with HTTP 422. `entity_not_found`: IODA returns an explicit entity 404. `upstream_rate_limited`: IODA returns HTTP 429. `upstream_queue_full`: The shared request queue is full. `upstream_timeout`: IODA does not answer within the per-attempt timeout or the invocation deadline; global searches slow sharply as extendWindowSeconds and the window grow. `upstream_schema`: IODA data or bucket metadata does not validate. `response_too_large`: The upstream body or combined response exceeds its byte budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Result interpretation and concrete next call.

more.description: Whether another row page may exist; no does not verify related-scope membership coverage

nextPage.description: Next page when another may exist and IODA can continue the request; absent from a full page it cannot continue, whose notice names the route to the rest

endpoint.description: Fixed HTTPS IODA upstream endpoint URL

truncated.description: A full page may have further records; not an exact total.

title: Ioda Get Alerts
